title: MVC
tagline: My Video Community (MVC) is a project aiming to allow the creators to manage their customer relationship based in memberships and content
description:
MVC empowers the creators, allowing them to create a better fans relationship and monetize their content through:
	
		- NFT Membership access model that allows:
			- Access a whitelist for exclusive events
			- Get notifications and updates about the Livestream
			
		- Unblock content linked to the event when
			- The fan access to a number of events
how_its_made:
This project enables the login with web3Auth, creates video NFTs with the decentralized video streaming network Livepeer, and enables whitelists for events using contracts on Polygon. The NFT smart contract is built using ERC721. 
Web3Auth helped me to connect wallets easily, Livepeer gave me the abstraction to upload video NFTs.
